notes.title: Gamepad Support
notes.content:
Jump with "Space", attack with left mouse button, right click to unsheath the sword.
Added gamepad support!

notes.title: New Enemies and Boss Level
notes.content:
The Guardian of the Forest (Boss Level) has been added to the next level from the Jungle levels.
Added 2 new enemies.
Some bugs fixed.
Jump with "Space", attack with left mouse button, right click to unsheath the sword.
Added gamepad support!

Added a dodge mechanic.
Improvements to the enemy AI were made.
Made player attacks a bit faster.

notes.title: Optimization and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Arrangements were made in Level 2 and Level 3
Fixed a bug in character's kick and sword attack animations.
Some bugs related to sounds have been fixed.

notes.title: New Character Customization
notes.content:
A whole new look for the main character!
Fixed various bugs with the character animations.
New camera system!
Upgrades to the Enemy AI (Skeletons are much more intelligent now!)
Made improvements in Tutorial Level.
Changed some trap designs in Level 3.
Fixed UI bugs.
Made tweaks to the gold pickup mechanics.
New game trailer and logo!
